setup: A disposable Go home uses the production Task worker, local Artifact service, and a self-hosted streamable HTTP packet sink with an always-ask policy.
verified: The Executor creates one Markdown Artifact with the exact invoice fields and EUR 416.50 calculation.
The upload review binds the selected destination, Artifact ID, Artifact version ID, and complete packet bytes.
The sink receives one upload after approval and returns a receipt.
The published Artifact bytes remain exact and the Task completes through Reviewer.
scope: Controlled Task packet creation and MCP upload. Browser delivery and the Chat route's missing Artifact authoring path remain separate product routes.
